QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Restful Herbs
QuestInfo.0: You've reached 1,700 meters, and are approaching the peak. The senior brother seems pale though, and you're starting to feel pretty tired too. Go talk to him.\t
QuestInfo.1: You're close to the peak but tiring out fast. Gather some herbs from nearby to recover your strength.
QuestInfo.2: Those Moonlight Posies really helped! Turns out the senior brother was pale because he's scared of heights. Looks like you're on your own now.

default.0: You need to find that Moonlight Posie before you pass out.
